malayan-water-monitor.reproduction: Females lay eggs beside decaying logs or stumps.

reticulated-python.pressures: Handling or cornering a python can cause stress or injury and provoke a defensive bite.

equatorial-spitting-cobra.watch: Back away and keep people and pets away. Never try to catch it. Seek urgent medical care after a bite or venom entering the eyes.
